props.text:
## Why compounding wins

A balance grows by a factor of **(1 + r)** each year, so after *n* years it is $P(1+r)^n$. Read more at [the docs](https://example.com/docs).

- Start early
- Be consistent

> Time in the market beats timing the market.

```
balance = principal * (1 + rate) ** years
```
